svg.aria-label: Plogger chips for [3] minor third, [4] major third, [5] perfect fourth, each beside the pair's identity colour bar, followed by the three-factor legend: shape is the family, shadow is fundamental or octave, fill is harmonicity.
svg.title: Plogger lens for the 2A pairs

g.text: Three marks, separate from the colour
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
A Shape (outline): jagged = dissonant family · rounded = modal family · straight = perfect-group
family. A family label, not a measured sound wave.
B Shadow (side): ← Fundamental [1]–[5] · ↔ Both [6] · → Octave [7]–[11]. Always paired with its arrow.
C Fill (inside): dense/dark = non-harmonic · open/light = harmonic · midtone dotted = neutral [6] ·
A historic teaching lens (Archived printed pictograph (R2_pictograph_reference.html) and
app/DiChordPictograph.tsx), not acoustic law. The identity colour is a separate, artistic label.
How to read this graphic: Each chip has three separate marks: the outline shape, a
shadow to the left, right or both sides, and the fill. The coloured bar beside it is the
interval identity colour, which is a different label. The legend underneath states every
mark in words and names the printed source this lens comes from.
